cases.before:
The build runs on every push to main. The tests run right after the build. The report lands in the shared log. The team reads the report each morning. The whole loop takes 9 minutes. The cache keeps the last 20 runs.

The queue drains at a steady rate. The workers pull from the same shard. The retry count sits at 3 attempts. The dead letter box holds 41 items. The alert fires at 100 items. The rota covers every weekday shift. The handover happens at 09:00 sharp.

We changed the shard key on 2026-02-11. The change landed in `internal/queue/shard.go` that day. The backlog cleared within the hour. Nobody has paged about it since then. The old key stayed in place for a week. We deleted it on the following Monday.

The dashboard shows the same four panels. The graph on the left tracks the depth. The graph beside it tracks the age. The panel below counts the retries. The last panel lists the failed jobs.
